title: Template action lines must not pop frame stack; conservatively mark all containers unresolved
context: The scanner was using template action line indentation to pop the frame stack, treating it like ordinary YAML structure. But template actions are indentation-agnostic—`{{-` chomps whitespace, and `| indent N` requires column 0 while injecting at depth N. At column 0, this annihilated the stack, reparenting all subsequent lines to root and silently losing all field-path tracking.
decision: Template action lines no longer touch the frame stack. Instead, they conservatively mark every currently-open container (root through innermost) as unresolved, since there is no way to know which ancestor the injection targets without parsing Helm expressions—and even then, conditionals can dynamically vary.
consequences: Stops stack annihilation that reparented all post-action lines to root
Prevents silent loss of field-path tracking and symbols after template actions
Prevents false-positive cross-resource edges from incomplete (partially-templated) selectors
Conservative correctness: taints potentially-affected containers rather than guessing or destroying tracking
alternatives_rejected: Parse the template action to infer which ancestor it targets (infeasible; Helm conditionals are dynamic)
Pop frame stack by action indentation (original; causes stack annihilation and data loss)
Mark only innermost container as unresolved (misses cases where action targets an ancestor)
